areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Clear fit: integrated mobility, drainage, urban redevelopment and public space investments; over 90% of resources linked; feasible targets; high impact.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Only indirect link through cycling infrastructure and a linear park; general objective not sport-oriented and most funds go to roads and drainage.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Drainage, linear park and area recovery give limited fit; environmental share around 16% and goals lack specific environmental results; low impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Only the drainage component and one specific objective relate to flood mitigation; under 10% of funds and no early-warning or risk-management elements.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Water is not a central axis; only partial links via the river park and a drainage indicator; under 10% of funds, so no acceptance.

not_accepted.name: Water security
not_accepted.reason: Water is not a central axis; only partial links via the river park and a drainage indicator; under 10% of funds, so no acceptance.
